mission: LÉLU 22.4 — what “Using other chats · 1 other chat used” actually measures

observed_in_m22_3.visible: Conversation B's activity card read “Using other chats — 1 other chat used”
observed_in_m22_3.payload: B's captured request contained none of A's material, no project names and no cross-chat label
observed_in_m22_3.recorded_then: flagged as a labelling nuance, not proven either way

reproduced_in_m22_4.turn: a brand-new conversation asked “What is my workshop access phrase? Answer in one short line.”

captured_request.quoted_text: From the chat “What is my workshop access phrase? A” (the user brought it up): - User: What is my workshop access phrase? Answer in one short line.

activity_steps.label: Used research from the chat “What is my workshop access phrase? A”
Related, not used (not linked): “Please remember this: my workshop ac”
Searching What is my workshop access phrase? Answer in one short line.

reproduced_in_m22_4.conclusion: the badge was accurate about the resolver's output and wrong about the world: the “other chat” was the conversation this very question was being asked in, and the “research” was the user's own sentence

root_causes.defect: A chat's full title was matched with a plain String.includes(). The chat created for that question was titled “What is my workshop access phrase? A”; the next question began “What is my workshop access phrase? Answer…”, so the title's trailing “A” matched the first letter of “Answer” and the chat counted as named.
root_causes.fix: containsTitle() requires the title to end on a word boundary and is used by namesChat and by CrossChatResolver's contained/fullyNamed logic.
root_causes.test: tests/live-agent.test.ts — a chat is only named by its title on word boundaries…

root_causes.defect: Candidate messages were scored without excluding the current turn's own text, so a conversation record holding this exact question could be selected and handed back to the model as another chat's research; the authorization was “named”/“asked”, so it counted as used.
root_causes.fix: isOwnTurn(message) excludes any message whose normalized text equals this turn's prompt from scoring, from the picked set and from the latest-answer fallback. The user's own words are never cross-chat material.
root_causes.test: tests/live-agent.test.ts — the same test asserts used=[] and no RESEARCH FROM OTHER CHATS block, while the positive linked-chat case still injects and labels content.

what_the_indicator_measures_now.counted_as_used: reference steps emitted by cross_chat_reference with status done (one per authorized source whose text was placed into this turn's request context), plus done chats.merge / chats.link tool results
not_counted: memories recalled (memory steps never produce the card at all)
drafts/related chats that were only discovered (they produce an info step: “Related, not used (not linked)”)
the current turn's own words (now excluded at the resolver)
a provider fallback (that is a provider step, shown separately)

reported_states.discovered: “Related, not used (not linked): …” — info step, no count
reported_states.inspected: chats.read produces a reference step naming the chat it read (it did read it)
reported_states.retrieved_memory: “Recalled N related memories” / “Checked memory — nothing related” — memory step, excluded from the card
reported_states.authorized: the source is admitted to the turn's context; only authorized sources ever appear in a used list
reported_states.injected: the labelled “RESEARCH FROM OTHER CHATS (authorized)” block reaches request.context, which is what the count claims
reported_states.rejected: never enters a used list; unauthorized chats appear only as the “not used” suggestion
reported_states.deferred: LÉLU asks whether to use the chat; nothing is counted (seen after reload: “Would you like me to pull in the earlier … conversation?” with badge “Web research · 1 search · 1 issue”)

tests_added: discovered but unauthorized: the related chat appears in suggested, never in used (existing test, still green)
authorized historical retrieval and actual injection: a linked chat's content appears in the labelled block (new positive control)
zero cross-chat retrieval: unrelated words → used=[], suggested=[]
own turn is not another chat: used=[], no research block
title boundary: “? A” does not name a chat for “? Answer”
